        int v, w, rev;
    };

        adj[u].push_back({v, fl, sz1});
        adj[v].push_back({u, 0, sz2});
    }
    vector<vector<node> > adj;
    vector<int> lev, edge_tried;
    int st, ed;
    networkflow(int V, int s, int t): adj(V), lev(V), edge_tried(V), st(s), ed(t){}

        fill(lev.begin(), lev.end(), -1);

        queue<int>que;que.push(st);

            int now =que.front();que.pop();
            for(int i=0; i<adj[now].size(); i++){
                int nxt = adj[now][i].v;

                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

        ll ret=0;
        while(assign_level()){
            fill(edge_tried.begin(), edge_tried.end(), 0);

                if(amt==0)break;
                ret+=amt;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }

                    adj[now][i].w-=nxtflow;
                    adj[nxt][adj[now][i].rev].w+=nxtflow;
                    return nxtflow;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

        }
